record.diagnosis: In a controlled programmable transaction, a 10,000,000 MIST coin was asked to split out 20,000,000 MIST; execution simulation failed with InsufficientCoinBalance.
record.safeProcedure: Trace the exact coin balance and preceding commands. Reduce the requested split to a supported amount and simulate again with the actual gas context before any signing. A 5,000,000 MIST split passed our controlled simulation; this is not a guaranteed fix for another transaction.
record.caveat: This is Tatum Mainnet SIMULATION with mock gas. It did not sign, execute or repair any historical transaction and has no independent human reviewer approval.
